04
synthesis

Deposit the quantum-dot composite

Syringe-pump feed to positive capillary electrode; grounded ring counterelectrode.4.5kVdc atomizes dispersion; aerosol enters heated growth zone while ZnSe matrix grows. Substrate temperature follows selected source variant. Reactor geometry/electrode dimensions are cited to reference2a, not restated.
